1\. Discotrade skips mid-mission rulings 🔗 Cross-repo conflict ≡ Correctness 
The new decisions-kit route tells operators to apply an owner file and use go, relying on the
added §R instruction to make the builder carry out its steps. Discotrade’s active mission 20 brief
has an older §R without that instruction, so a mid-mission decisions kit can be committed while the
resumed builder continues from its checkpoint without acting on the ruling.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The decisions-kit-and-go route depends on recovery wording absent from discotrade’s active brief. ## Fix Focus Areas - templates/BUILDER-N-PROMPT.md[98-101] - docs/ARCHITECT-HANDBOOK.md[843-853] - meta/BUILDER-20-PROMPT.md[128-136] ## Recommended Fix Update discotrade’s active and future mission briefs with the owner-file recovery rule before recommending this route there, or provide a compatible route for briefs that lack it. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
